content.caption: Xiaoxue maintains her royal dignity even when her kingdom is currently under siege by a single, rogue piece of rogue toilet paper.
content.scene: A hand-painted book illustration of Xiaoxue, a long-haired white cat with striking blue eyes, sitting regally atop a laundry basket. She stares with calm, judgmental intensity at a long trail of white toilet paper draped over her paw, her pink nose twitching slightly amidst the domestic clutter.
content.topic: Graceful appearance versus ordinary household chaos
